testcase.system-out: Scenario: Navigate an expanded model browser while ribbon key tips are visible ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with the full 3D Model ribbon visible in the MCAD Software ✔ And an extrusion is expanded in the model browser to show its child sketch ✔ And the extrusion is selected in the browser ✔ When the user presses Alt to show top-level ribbon key tips ✔ And the user presses Down Arrow ✔ Then the child sketch is selected in the browser ✔ And the corresponding sketch geometry is highlighted in the viewport ✔ And the top-level ribbon key tips remain visible ✔ When the user presses Up Arrow ✔ Then the extrusion is selected again ✔ And the top-level ribbon key tips remain visible ✔ When the user presses Alt ✔ Then the ribbon key tips disappear
